name: live_query_proto
about: The unavailable-service path on a unary RPC: `loams.live.v1` is a `full`-variant engine, so every one of its RPCs answers `unimplemented` with reason `feature_not_in_variant` and the variant in `metadata`. (The binary encoding, which is what an SDK sends by default.)

body.message: loams.live.v1.LiveService/Query is not in the standard variant
